rv.q: Is cynicism supposed to be this energizing?
Even at the top of their game, these guys in Mamet’s corrosively observed world are doomed to keep looking over their shoulder at the next potential downfall.
Neil Pepe's fine-tuned revival makes for an entertaining ride.

cn.t: Mamet's Hollywood satire gets a fast-paced, entertaining revival that may not represent the playwright's deepest work but delivers sharp performances and whiplash-inducing velocity across a brisk 85 minutes.
